testimonials.text: Wore my Batik Pawang to a Hari Raya open house and lost count of the compliments. It breathes in the heat and no one else had the same print.
testimonials.name: Amirul Hakim

testimonials.text: You can feel the hand-work in it — the weight, the way the colour sits in the cloth. A grown man's shirt, not a novelty print.
testimonials.name: Tan Wei Jie

testimonials.text: Bought one for my brother's wedding and now I reach for it every Batik Thursday at the office. Knowing it's one of one makes it special.
testimonials.name: Arvind Raj

testimonials.text: Ordered on WhatsApp, paid by QR, and the shirt reached Sabah well packed. The stitching to my size was spot on.
testimonials.name: Faizal Rahman

testimonials.text: The short-sleeve is my weekend shirt now — pure cotton, cool in Ipoh's heat, and the print gets people talking.
testimonials.name: Daniel Lim
